features.name: Mystical Erudition
features.description:
Upon choosing this tradition at 3rd level, you can spend 1 ki point to gain advantage on INT (Arcana), INT (History), or INT (Religion) checks.

You also learn one language of your choice. You gain additional languages at 11th and 17th level.

features.name: Extract Aspects
features.description:
Beginning at 3rd level, when you hit a single creature with two or more attacks in one round, you can spend 1 ki point to force it to make a CON save. On failure, learn one aspect of the creature (your choice): Creature Type, AC, Senses, Highest Save Modifier, Lowest Save Modifier, Damage Vulnerabilities, Damage Resistances, Damage Immunities, or Condition Immunities.

At 6th level: 2 aspects. At 11th: 3. At 17th: 4.

features.name: Extort Truth
features.description: At 6th level, if you hit a single creature with two or more attacks in one round, you can spend 2 ki points to force a CHA save. On failure, the creature cannot speak a deliberate lie for 1 minute. You know whether it succeeded or failed. The creature is aware of the effect and may be evasive.

features.name: Mind of Mercury
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, you can take additional reactions each round equal to your INT modifier (minimum 1), at the cost of 1 ki point per reaction beyond the first. Only one reaction per trigger.

Additionally, you can spend 1 ki point to gain advantage on INT (Investigation) checks.

features.name: Preternatural Counter
features.description: Beginning at 11th level, if a creature misses you with an attack, you can immediately use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.

payload.name: Preternatural Counter
payload.description: When a creature misses you with an attack, make a melee attack against it.

features.name: Debilitating Barrage
features.description:
Upon reaching 17th level, when you hit a single creature with three or more attacks in one round, you can spend 3 ki points to impose disadvantage on its attack rolls until the end of your next turn and force a CON save. On failure, the creature gains vulnerability to a damage type of your choice for 1 minute or until it takes damage of that type. Creatures already resistant or immune to the chosen type are unaffected.

Choose from: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, piercing, poison, psychic, radiant, slashing, thunder.
